title: Tiny Desk Tidy
intro: Small jobs that take about two minutes each. Pick one that suits the moment and ignore the rest.

cards.back: Pick a single patch of desk, about the size of a book, and put everything on it where it belongs.
Take any cups, glasses or plates to the kitchen. Fill your water glass on the way back.
Untangle one cable, or tuck loose ones out of the way. Small changes show.
Pick three browser tabs you are finished with and close them.
A soft dry cloth is usually enough. Check what your screen maker recommends first.
Keep the ones you still need, and recycle the ones that have done their job.
Move a few loose files on your desktop into folders, or into the bin.
Look at your to-do list for the day and cross off anything that is no longer true.
Adjust your seat so your feet rest on the floor and your arms feel relaxed.
Find an item that lives somewhere else and return it home.
